Class PrimaryMirrorSegmentConstants

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.tmt.aps.peas.config.model.PrimaryMirrorSegmentConstants

  • public class PrimaryMirrorSegmentConstants
extends Object
    Constants data class containing primary mirror segment constants. This class is populated from database data in the Constant class and is made available to executors and the user interface controllers in the ConstantsCache.
